summary: GigCapital7 Corp. filed an 8-K reporting additional non-redemption agreements with public stockholders ahead of its May 7, 2026 extraordinary general meeting to approve its business combination with Hadron Energy, Inc. The agreements cover an additional 200,000 Class A ordinary shares, bringing total non-redeemed shares to 2,000,000. Under the Business Combination Agreement, GigCapital7 will redomicile to Delaware, Hadron will merge into Merger Sub, and the combined entity will be renamed Hadron Energy, Inc. The non-redemption agreements are designed to reduce trust redemptions and ensure sufficient cash for the deal. Watch for shareholder vote results and closing conditions; risk-arb focuses on redemption levels and deal approval.
